title: SessionStatusResult
description: `session.status` response payload. Non-consuming: reading the takeover state never clears the held flag nor the return receipt.

held_for_ms.description: How long the user has held control, in milliseconds. `None` while `control` is `agent`.

last_return.description: Most recent return receipt, until it is consumed by `session.wait_control`.

pending_interrupt.description: Whether the one-shot user-interrupt marker is still pending.

SessionControl.description:
Who currently owns a session's page control.

`Agent` is the default: the daemon routes the agent's tool calls into the Agent Window. `User` (“held”) means the user pressed “Take over” in the Agent Window; interrupt-gated tool calls are rejected with `ErrorCode::UserAborted` until control is returned.

SessionReturnReceipt.description: Receipt recorded when the user returns control to the agent.

held_ms.description: How long the user held control, in milliseconds.

note.description: Free-form note the user typed before returning control. May be empty when the user returned control without a message.
